reviews.title: Not a free trial if you have to pay Immediately?
reviews.text:
I signed up for what I understood to be a free trial. The app only showed me one trial option for $15, so I signed up, and I was IMMEDIATELY charged $16 and some change. I’m not sure why I was charged at all if it was supposed to be a free trial, or why the actual charge was more than the $15 it showed me.

Once I opened the app, I honestly wasn’t impressed with the content either. It did listen to my likes/dislikes and change the restaurant food groups accordingly, but it didn’t really account for my actual goals. For example, I asked for the lowest-calorie options, but the app would recommend something like mac and cheese when there were clearly lower-calorie options on the menu, such as a salad or even fries. It didn’t give me the actual menu insight I was looking for, so I basically felt like I paid for the app and got nothing useful out of it.

I emailed them about the charge, and they told me they couldn’t do anything because 1. They didn’t know which subscription I purchased, although it only gave me the one option and shouldn’t be an issue anyways if it said “free trial” before it and 2. I purchased the subscription through Apple and that I needed to resolve it independently through Apple, so it basically wasn’t their problem. The frustrating part is that buying through Apple was the ONLY option the app gave me when I signed up for the trial in the first place, and that it was the ONLY subscription choice it gave me, and they made it seem like it was my fault that I purchased it this way.

Overall, I’m pretty disappointed and would absolutely not recommend this app to anybody

reviews.title: Needs better UI
reviews.text: Too many bugs. When onboarding, if you take a screenshot, it quits the entire onboarding process and brings you back to the first page. It also displays multiple locations of the same restaurant separately when adding to your favorites. These restaurants may have different price ranges displayed despite having the same menu and menu prices. It also has AI graphics, which makes me suspect the app itself was vibe coded. Not good and not well tested, despite what the reviews say! Minor things like having a dial bar for your weight (that defaults to 280???) that you have to manually scroll vs just a box to type it in really make the app feel poorly thought out. Overall, the onboarding process was bad enough that I just deleted the app. Why would I trust something with my health that didn’t have enough care to work well with its users?
